business_summary.text: Gateway Distriparks is an integrated multimodal logistics player in India, operating rail-linked ICDs, CFS, and a cold chain subsidiary (Snowman Logistics), with a focus on the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹533.65 Cr (-0.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹60.59 Cr (against a loss of ₹193.1 Cr a year earlier).
Gateway Distriparks presented its Q4 & FY26 financial results and investor presentation, announcing a new ICD project in Indore.
Gateway Distriparks issued a corrigendum on May 07, 2026 to correct a typographical error in its FY26 consolidated balance sheet heading.
Gateway Distriparks hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 7, 2026, highlighting subdued volumes from geopolitical headwinds and long-term expansion plans.
Prism International Private Limited, as Gateway Distriparks Limited’s promoter, declared no encumbrance on its 24.09% shares during FY2025-26.

Perfect Communications Private Limited, led by Managing Director Prem Kishan Dass Gupta (DIN: 00011670), declared no encumbrance of its 4.26% stake in Gateway Distriparks Limited during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
Prem Kishan Dass Gupta, Mamta Gupta, Ishaan Gupta, and Samvid Gupta declared no encumbrance on their Gateway Distriparks shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26 as of March 31, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹580.13 Cr (+2.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹57.94 Cr (-13.5% YoY).
Gateway Distriparks reported Q2FY27 consolidated EBITDA of ₹131.51 Cr and PAT of ₹58.53 Cr, while announcing the upcoming start of EXIM operations at Ankleshwar MMLP in Q3FY27.
